description: AI-generate a landing page from a goal. Returns the page id (rcp_*) plus a spec with hero / value_props / features / social_proof / faq / cta sections. Optionally bind a form_id so the page's CTA enrolls submitters into a sequence. The page is created in 'draft' status — call rc_page_publish to go live.

form_id.description: Existing rcf_* to embed in the CTA section

goal.description: What the page should do — AI infers structure + copy

override_spec.description: Skip AI; use this spec directly

name: rc_page_create
